name: Whisper Turbo
summary: Transcribe or translate audio with Whisper Large V3 Turbo on the GPU, with timestamped JSON segments.

source.notes: Converted from the local UI workflow. LoadAudio feeds WhisperLargeV3RepackTranscribeAudio, then two SaveText nodes keep the transcript and the timestamped segments JSON. The local node uses the Transformers/PyTorch Whisper path on ROCm instead of CTranslate2, so automatic device selection stays on the GPU.

inputs.label: Audio
inputs.help: Audio or video file to transcribe. Upload it or record it with the microphone.

inputs.label: Whisper model
inputs.help: Turbo is already downloaded and runs on the GPU. Large V3 is more accurate but downloads its Transformers weights on first use.

inputs.label: Device
inputs.help: Both options use the GPU. There is intentionally no CPU option in this app.

inputs.label: Language
inputs.help: Optional ISO code such as fr, en or ja. Leave empty for automatic detection.

inputs.label: Beam size
inputs.help: Higher values search more decoding paths. Five is the workflow default.

inputs.label: Word timestamps
inputs.help: On: timestamp every word in segments_json. Off: timestamp sentence-level segments.

notes: The first run downloads the Hugging Face Whisper weights into the ComfyUI Hugging Face cache. The local node is patched to use Transformers/PyTorch on the AMD GPU; CTranslate2/faster-whisper on ROCm is not used for automatic or CUDA device selection. The transcript and segments are saved as .txt outputs in History.
